headline: ZERO T7 clip banks exist in game/assets/anim/ (only t3/ + oss/ + made/). Every T7 move in the overlay therefore has anim_ref UNMAPPED with an exact lookup key. This index is the wiring map for the extraction lane; it is not a bank.
bank8000_rule: PAKCHUNK0 RULED OUT (coordinator update 2026-10-24, completed pakchunk lane, proven exhaustively; full report ~/workspace/gapfill-20261024/pakchunk8000/PAKCHUNK8000_REPORT.md): teardown/pakchunk0/manifest.json (74,872 bytes) contains ONLY meshes (200) + textures (622) — zero anim/MOTA/clip/skeleton/uasset/pak entries (the 12 'motion' hits are the substring of 'promotion' in UI texture names). Tree: 1,734 entries, NO .uasset/.pak/.utoc/.bin/.arc. GLBs verified: no animations key, skeletons only — usable for retargeting, CANNOT supply clips. CONCLUSION: bank 0x8000 moves (frv 1,593 + dnc 1,527) stay CLIP-UNRESOLVED. Do NOT wait on pakchunk0, do NOT substitute another bank's clips. PRIMARY UNBLOCK (parent browser/live-game delegation): LIVE-MEMORY extraction — TKMovesets2 on a Windows box running owned T7: load Raven then Chloe in practice, export P1 each, confirm a ~1,702-entry MOTA before wiring anything. Join key stays exact: anim_ref minus 0x8000; any recovered clip must start 00 64 or 00 C8 before it is trusted.
